name: Webform Statistics
description: Provides statistics for webform submissions by date ranges
project_description:
This module offers an easy way to monitor and evaluate the number of submissions to your webforms over a specific time period. It’s ideal for users who need insight into which forms are being used most actively and when. As the module evolves, it will provide even deeper analytics to help webmasters optimize user interactions and improve form performance.

 

 Features 
 Focus on relevant webforms : Display only the webforms that require analysis, helping administrators concentrate on those with strategic importance or higher impact.

 Time-based data filtering : Retrieve submission data by day, week, or month to better evaluate the effectiveness and performance trends of each webform over time.

 Interactive data visualization : Generate dynamic, interactive charts based on submission data to identify trends, user behavior, and which forms contribute most to conversions or revenue.

 

 Future versions will include trends over time, conversion insights, and comparison tools to evaluate the effectiveness of different forms.

 Use cases include: 
 
 A marketing team tracking lead form performance. 
 Site admins analyzing user feedback form usage. 
 Editors identifying underperforming surveys for optimization. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing Webform Statistics, navigate to the Webform Submissions administration section ( /admin/structure/webform/submissions/manage ). Multiple statistics tabs will be available. From there, you can select the form and choose a date range to view submission counts.

 No additional setup is required, but permissions may need to be configured so only appropriate roles can access statistics. Only roles with "administer webform submissions" permission will have access to this data.

 Additional Requirements 
 Webform module is required.

Views module is required.

 Charts module is required.

 No external libraries or APIs are needed at this time.

 Similar projects 
 Webform Analysis : Provides data visualizations and statistics related to each submission field, not about forms.

 Webform Statistics focuses on simplicity and fast access to key metrics, with a roadmap toward more features while maintaining ease of use.
